headline: Trump threatens sanctions on US companies that build data centers abroad
summary: US President Donald Trump threatened to impose harsh sanctions on American companies that build data centers in other countries. He specifically named China as a rival in the remarks.
why: Data centers are core infrastructure for cloud computing and artificial intelligence, and US tech and cloud firms invest heavily in overseas capacity.
original_headline: Trump amenaza con sanciones a empresas de EU que construyan centros de datos en el extranjero
